question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"perfectly"** means in a manner that is without flaws or defects.
 
• In the context, knowing something **perfectly** suggests having complete knowledge or understanding of it.
 
• The other options: "doubtfully," "closely," and "loosely" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "For all that I knew this perfectly__ well,......"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Doubtfully (संदेहेपूर्ण)**: means uncertainly or hesitantly.
 
• **Closely (नज़दीकी से)**: means in a way that involves careful observation or attention to detail.
 
• **Loosely (ढीलेपन से)**: means in a relaxed or not tight manner.
